rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that is not compulsory.

example.traditional: 呢個活動唔一定要參加。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 wut6 dung6 m4 jat1 ding6 jiu3 caam1 gaa1

rows.note: Use this when highlighting that the person can choose whether to include or do it.

example.english: Dessert is optional; you don't have to have it.
example.traditional: 甜品係可選擇嘅，你唔食都得。
example.jyutping: tim4 ban2 hai6 ho2 syun2 zaak6 ge3 nei5 m4 sik6 dou1 dak1

rows.note: Use this mainly for optional participation or action chosen freely rather than required.

example.english: Donating this time is optional, and no one will force you.
example.traditional: 今次捐款係自願，唔會迫你。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 gyun1 fun2 hai6 zi6 jyun6 m4 wui5 bik1 nei5
